entries.buff_desc_spelleffects: This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
entries.buff_teemopassive_summary: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.
entries.buff_teemopassive_tooltip:
If Teemo stands still for @StealthCooldownDuration@ seconds without being damaged, he becomes Invisible until he moves. While in a brush, he can maintain Invisibility while moving.

Upon exiting this Invisibility, Teemo gains @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.
entries.game_character_passivedescription_chogat: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.
entries.game_character_passivedescription_malphi: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.
entries.game_character_passivedescription_olaf: Olaf gains up to <attackSpeed>@MaxAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and @MaxLifeSteal@ Life Steal, based on his missing Health.
entries.game_character_passivesummary_olaf: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.
entries.game_character_passivetooltip_chogath: Killing an enemy restores <scaleLevel>@ChogathCarnivoreHeal@</scaleLevel> Health and <scaleLevel>@ChogathCarnivoreMana@</scaleLevel> Mana.
entries.game_character_passivetooltip_malphite: Malphite grants himself <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> after not taking damage for @PassiveCooldown@ seconds.
entries.reminder_camouflage: <keywordStealth>Camouflaged</keywordStealth> units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
entries.reminder_invisibility: <keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> units cannot be revealed except by turrets or <font color='#ee91d7'>True Sight</font color>.
entries.reminder_untargetable: Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been hit by them.
entries.spell_caitlynaceinthehole_summary: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.
entries.spell_caitlynaceinthehole_tooltip:
Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing @RTotalDamage@ physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.
entries.spell_caitlynentrapment_summary: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.
entries.spell_caitlynentrapment_tooltip: Caitlyn fires a net, pushing her backwards. The net <status>Slows</status> the first target hit by @SlowAmount@% for @SlowDuration@ second and deals <magicDamage>@NetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_caitlynp_summary: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.
entries.spell_caitlynp_tooltip:
Every @AttacksPerHeadshot@ Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as @BrushAttackTotal@ for building towards a Headshot.

Headshots deal an additional @HeadShotBonusDamage@ physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by {{Spell_CaitlynEntrapment_Name}} and {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}}. Headshots against enemies hit by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} deal a further @spell.CaitlynW:HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage.
entries.spell_caitlynp_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_CaitlynP_Tooltip}}

Headshot damage scales with level, Critical Strike Chance, and Critical Strike Damage.
Headshots deal an additional @HeadShotMinionBonusDamage@ physical damage to non-champions.
Extra damage on trapped targets scales with {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} rank.
entries.spell_caitlynpiltoverpeacemaker_summary: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).
entries.spell_caitlynpiltoverpeacemaker_tooltip:
Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing @InitialDamage@ physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals @SecondaryDamage@ physical damage.

Enemies revealed by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} always take full damage.
entries.spell_caitlynyordletrap_summary: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.
entries.spell_caitlynyordletrap_tooltip:
Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for @RootDuration@ seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for @TrapDuration@ seconds, and @MaximumTraps@ traps may be active at once. This Ability has @MaximumCharges@ charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional @HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage from Headshot.
entries.spell_dianaorbs_summary: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.
entries.spell_dianaorbs_tooltip:
Diana creates three orbiting spheres for @ShieldDuration@ seconds that explode on contact, each dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage, up to a max of @TotalMaxDamage@ damage.

Diana also gains @ShieldValue@ Shield for the same duration. When the last sphere detonates, she gains an additional @ShieldValue@ Shield and refreshes the duration.
entries.spell_dianapassive_summary: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
entries.spell_dianapassive_tooltip:
Diana gains @BonusAS@ Attack Speed, increased to @EmpoweredAS@ for @BuffDuration@ seconds after using an Ability.

Every third Attack cleaves nearby enemies for an additional @CleaveDamage@ magic damage.
entries.spell_dianaq_summary:
Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.

Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.
entries.spell_dianaq_tooltip:
Diana unleashes an arc of lunar energy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and marking with Moonlight for @MoonlightDuration@ seconds.

Moonlight reveals enemies that are not stealthed.
entries.spell_dianar_summary:
Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.

If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.
entries.spell_dianar_tooltip:
Diana Pulls In, Slows by @SlowTooltip@%, and reveals nearby enemies for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

If Diana hits at least one enemy champion, she calls to the moon, dealing @RExplosionDamage@ magic damage plus @RMultihitAmplification@ for each champion pulled beyond the first, up to a max of an additional @MaxDamage@ damage.
entries.spell_dianateleport_summary:
Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.

Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.
entries.spell_dianateleport_tooltip: Diana becomes as the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If the target is afflicted with <keywordMajor>Moonlight</keywordMajor>, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.
entries.spell_evelynne_summary: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.
entries.spell_evelynne_tooltip:
Evelynn whips an enemy, dealing @BaseDamage@ plus @PercentHealthBaseTOOLTIP@ max Health magic damage. Evelynn gains @SpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @SpeedDuration@ seconds.

Entering Demon Shade refreshes this Ability's cooldown and empowers it. When this Ability is empowered, Evelynn dashes to the target and deals @EmpoweredDamage@ plus @PercentHealthEmpoweredTOOLTIP@ max Health magic damage to her target and everyone she passes through instead.
entries.spell_evelynne_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This Ability applies On-Hit Effects to the targeted enemy.</rules>
entries.spell_evelynnpassive_summary: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.
entries.spell_evelynnpassive_tooltip:
Evelynn enshrouds herself in her Demon Shade after @DemonShadeTimer@ seconds of not Attacking or using Abilities. Demon Shade restores @HealPerSecondTOOLTIP@ Health per second while below @HealingThresholdTOOLTIP@ Health. From level 6 onward, it also grants Camouflage.

Taking damage from champions or towers removes Demon Shade for @StealthDropTimer@ seconds.
entries.spell_evelynnpassive_tooltipextended:
Evelynn enshrouds herself in her Demon Shade after @DemonShadeTimer@ seconds of not attacking or using abilities. Demon Shade restores @HealPerSecondTOOLTIP@ Health per second while below @HealingThresholdTOOLTIP@ Health. From level 6 onward, it also grants Camouflage.

Taking damage from champions or turrets removes Demon Shade for @StealthDropTimer@ seconds.

Camouflaged units cannot be seen unless an enemy champion is inside their detection radius.
entries.spell_evelynnq_summary: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.
entries.spell_evelynnq_tooltip:
Evelynn strikes with her Lasher, dealing @MissileDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and causing Evelynn's next 3 Attacks or Abilities on that unit to deal an additional @TotalBonusDamage@ magic damage. Evelynn can Recast this Ability up to @QStackCount@ times.

Recast: Evelynn fires spikes through the nearest enemy, dealing @MissileDamage@ magic damage to all enemies hit.
entries.spell_evelynnq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The spikes prioritizes the target Evelynn is attacking.</rules>
entries.spell_evelynnr_summary: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.
entries.spell_evelynnr_tooltip: Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing heavy damage, becoming Untargetable and teleporting backwards. She deals <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increased to <magicDamage>@CritDamage@</magicDamage> against enemies below <healing>30% Health</healing>. Upon cast, set Demon Shade to a 1.25 second cooldown.
entries.spell_evelynnw_summary: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.
entries.spell_evelynnw_tooltip:
Evelynn marks a champion or monster for 5 seconds. If Evelynn hits the target with an Attack or Ability, she will expunge the mark, refund its cost, and Slow the target by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

If the mark lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it has extra effects:
  • Against champions: Charms them for @CharmDuration@ second(s) and removes @MRShred*100@% Magic Resist for @ShredDuration@ seconds.
  • Against monsters: Charms them for @MonsterCharm@ seconds and deals @MonsterDamageTotalTOOLTIP@ magic damage.
entries.spell_evelynnw_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Using this Ability does not remove Evelynn from <keywordMajor>Demon Shade</keywordMajor>.</rules>
entries.spell_eyeofthestorm_summary: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
entries.spell_eyeofthestorm_tooltip:
Janna grants an ally champion or turret @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. While shielded, they gain @TotalAD@ Attack Damage.

Janna refunds @ECDRefundforCC*100@% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.
entries.spell_feast_summary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.
entries.spell_feast_tooltip: Cho'Gath ravenously feeds on an enemy, dealing <trueDamage>@RDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to champions or <trueDamage>@RMonsterDamage@</trueDamage> to minions or jungle monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a stack, which causes him to grow in size and gain <healing>@RHealthPerStack@ max Health</healing>. Only @RMinionMaxStacks@ stacks can be gained from minions and non-epic jungle monsters.
entries.spell_feast_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Current minion and non-epic jungle monster stacks: @f3@/@RMinionMaxStacks@
Cho'Gath gains bonus attack and Feast cast range based upon his stacks:
@AttackRangePerStack@ Attack Range per stack (max @MaxBonusAttackRange@).
@CastRangePerStack@ Cast Range per stack (max @MaxBonusCastRange@).
entries.spell_feralscream_summary: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.
entries.spell_feralscream_tooltip: Cho'Gath roars, <status>Silencing</status> enemies for @Effect2Amount@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_fizze_summary: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.
entries.spell_fizze_tooltip:
Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals @EDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.
entries.spell_fizzpassive_summary: Fizz can move through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources
entries.spell_fizzpassive_tooltip: Fizz is Ghosted and takes @DamageReductionCalc@ reduced damage from all sources.
entries.spell_fizzpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_FizzPassive_Tooltip}}

Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
Damage reduction modified to @MonsterDamageReductionCalc@ against jungle monsters.
Damage cannot be reduced by more than @DamageReductionMax*100@%.
entries.spell_fizzq_summary: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.
entries.spell_fizzq_tooltip: Fizz dashes through an enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> plus <magicDamage>@QDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_fizzr_summary: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.
entries.spell_fizzr_tooltip:
Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit. The victim is afflicted with True Sight and Slowed by between 40% to 80% based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.

After @DetonationTime@ seconds a shark erupts on the target, Knocking Up the target with the fish for 1 second, Knocking Back everything else, and dealing between @SmallSharkDamage@ to @BigSharkDamage@ magic damage based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.
entries.spell_fizzw_summary: Fizz's attacks bleed his enemies, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Fizz can empower his next attack to deal bonus damage and empower his further attacks for a short time.
entries.spell_fizzw_tooltip:
Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing @DoTDamage@ magic damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds.

Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional @ActiveDamage@ magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds @OnKillManaRefund@ Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to @OnKillNewCooldown@ second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional @OnHitBuffDamage@ magic damage for @OnHitBuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_fizzw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Attacks deal @BonusMonsterDamage@ bonus damage to jungle monsters.
Attacks deal @TurretMod*100@% damage to structures.
entries.spell_gwene_summary: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.
entries.spell_gwene_tooltip:
Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

Empowered Attacks gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed, @OnHitDamage@ magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit, @BonusAttackRange@ range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds @CDRefund*100@% of this Ability's Cooldown.
entries.spell_gwenp_summary: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.
entries.spell_gwenp_tooltip: Gwen's Attacks deal an additional @PercentHealth1000Cuts@ Max Health magic damage on hit. Gwen recovers Health equal to @HealingPercent@ of the damage this Ability deals to champions, up to a maximum of @healcap@.
entries.spell_gwenp_tooltipextended:
{{ spell_gwenP_tooltip }}
Max damage to monsters: @MonsterDamageCap@. Deals @ExecuteDamage@ bonus damage to minions below @ExecuteThreshold*100@% health.
entries.spell_gwenq_summary: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.
entries.spell_gwenq_tooltip:
Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts @BuffDuration@ seconds).

Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for @MiniSwipeDamage@ magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for @FinalSwipeDamage@ magic damage.

The center of each strikes converts @TrueDamageConversion*100@% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit.

Deals @MinionMod*100@% damage to minions.
Minions below @ExecuteThreshold*100@% health take @ExecuteBonus@% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.
entries.spell_gwenq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Max damage: @MaxDamage@, plus @spell.GwenP:PassiveMaxQTooltip@ percent health from <spellName>A Thousand Cuts</spellName></rules>.
entries.spell_gwenr_summary:
Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit.

This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.
entries.spell_gwenr_tooltip:
First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage, Slows by @InitialSlow*-100@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds (@LockoutTime@s cooldown between casts).

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal @TotalDamage3@ magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal @TotalDamage5@ magic damage
entries.spell_gwenr_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Subsequent needle hits on the same unit Slow by @SubsequentSlow*-100@% instead.
Max damage: @MaxDamage@, plus @spell.GwenP:PassiveMaxRTooltip@ max health damage from A Thousand Cuts.
entries.spell_gwenw_summary: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.
entries.spell_gwenw_tooltip:
Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for @ZoneDuration@ seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains @TotalResists@ Armor and Magic Resist.

Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.
entries.spell_hecarimpassive_summary: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.
entries.spell_hecarimpassive_tooltip: Hecarim gains <scaleAD>@BonusAD@ Attack Damage</scaleAD>, increasing based on level.
entries.spell_hecarimpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_HecarimPassive_Tooltip}}

Attack Damage scales with bonus Move speed.
entries.spell_hecarimramp_summary: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.
entries.spell_hecarimramp_tooltip: Hecarim becomes Ghosted and gains <speed>@MinMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> increasing to <speed>@MaxMoveSpeed*100@%</speed> over @Duration@ seconds. His next Attack <status>Knocks Back</status> and deals between <physicalDamage>@MinDamage@</physicalDamage> and <physicalDamage>@MaxDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. <status>Knock Back</status> distance and damage scales with distance travelled during this Ability.
entries.spell_hecarimramp_tooltipextendedbelowli:
Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
The remaining duration of this Ability is paused during {{Spell_HecarimUlt_Name}}.
{{ buff_desc_SpellEffects }}
entries.spell_hecarimrapidslash_summary: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages.
entries.spell_hecarimrapidslash_tooltip: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies for @Damage@ physical damage. If this Ability hits, he gains a stack that decreases its Cooldown by @RampageCooldownReduction@ seconds and increases its damage by @RampageBonusDamagePerc@% for @BuffDuration@ seconds. Stacks up to @MaxStacks@ times.
entries.spell_hecarimrapidslash_tooltipextendedb: <rules>Deals a base of <physicalDamage>@MinionDamage@ damage</physicalDamage> to minions.</rules>
entries.spell_hecarimult_summary: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.
entries.spell_hecarimult_tooltip: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing <magicDamage>@DamageDone@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that <status>Fears</status> for between @FearDurationMin@ to @FearDurationMax@ seconds, increased by charge distance.
entries.spell_hecarimult_tooltipextendedbelowlin: <rules>Hecarim will move to the targeted location, but the riders always move the full distance.</rules>
entries.spell_hecarimw_summary: Hecarim gains Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and gains Health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.
entries.spell_hecarimw_tooltip:
Hecarim deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @BuffDuration@ seconds to nearby enemies.

Hecarim gains @ResistAmount@ Armor and Magic Resist and heals for @LeechAmount@% of damage nearby enemies take from Hecarim and @AllyTooltipLeachValue@% of damage taken from his allies.
entries.spell_hecarimw_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Hecarim cannot heal more than <healing>@MinionHealCap@ Health</healing> from minions or jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_howlinggale_summary: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
entries.spell_howlinggale_tooltip: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over @MaxDuration@ seconds then blows along its path. It deals <magicDamage>@MinimumDamage@ - @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> for @BaseKnockup@ - @MaxKnockup@ seconds. The distance, damage, and <status>Knock Up</status> duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can <recast>Recast</recast> to send the tornado early.
entries.spell_howlinggale_tooltipextendedbelowli: <rules>Deals an additional <magicDamage>@ExtraDamagePerSecondCharged@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Knocks Up</status> for an additional @ChargeKnockup@ seconds, and travels @ChargeDistancePercent@% farther for each second it grew, and always reaches its destination in @MissileTravelTime@ seconds.</rules>
entries.spell_kaylee_summary:
Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks.

Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.
entries.spell_kaylee_tooltip:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional @EPassiveTotalDamage@ magic damage.

Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional @ActiveTotalExecuteDamage@ missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level @Spell.KaylePassive:LevelForPassiveRank2@, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
entries.spell_kaylee_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This Ability applies on-hit and spell effects. Max @MaxExecuteVsMonsters@ bonus damage vs. jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_kaylepassive_summary: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.
entries.spell_kaylepassive_tooltip:
Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points.

  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank0@ - Zealous: Attacks grant @EnrageTotalASPerStack@% Attack Speed for @EnrageDuration@ seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining @MSTowardsEnemy*100@% Move Speed.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank1@ - Arisen: Attack range is increased to @UpgradedAttackRange@.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank2@ - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal @PassiveWaveDamage@ magic damage.
  • Level @LevelForPassiveRank3@ - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to @FinalAttackRange@.
entries.spell_kaylepassive_tooltipextended:
{{ Spell_KaylePassive_Tooltip }}
Fire waves apply spell effects and can Critically Strike.
entries.spell_kayleq_summary: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.
entries.spell_kayleq_tooltip: Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Slowing</status> by @SlowPercent@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds, and removing <scaleArmor>@ShredPercent@% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @ShredDuration@ seconds from the target and enemies behind them.
entries.spell_kayler_summary: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.
entries.spell_kayler_tooltip: Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for @InvulnDuration@ seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies.
entries.spell_kaylew_summary: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.
entries.spell_kaylew_tooltip: Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring <healing>@TotalHeal@ Health</healing> and granting <speed>@TotalHaste@ Move Speed</speed> for @HasteDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_kaylew_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>If cast without a target, this Ability will heal the most wounded ally in range.</rules>
entries.spell_kogmawbioarcanebarrage_summary: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>.
entries.spell_kogmawbioarcanebarrage_tooltip: Kog'Maw gains @Range@ Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalHealthDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_kogmawbioarcanebarrage_tooltipexte: <rules>Deals a maximum of <magicDamage>@MonsterDamageCap@ magic damage</magicDamage> to Monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_kogmawicathiansurprise_summary: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.
entries.spell_kogmawicathiansurprise_tooltip: For @TooltipPassiveDuration@ seconds after dying, Kog'Maw can continue to move, can move through units, and gains <speed>10% Move Speed</speed>, increasing to <speed>@TooltipPassiveMS*100@% Move Speed</speed> over the duration. At the end of the duration, he explodes and deals <trueDamage>@PassiveDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> to nearby enemies.
entries.spell_kogmawlivingartillery_summary: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.
entries.spell_kogmawlivingartillery_tooltip:
Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing @BaseDamageCalc@ plus @TooltipMissingHealthDamageAmp@% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take @MaxDamageCalc@ magic damage.

Subsequent shots within @ManaCostDuration@ seconds cost an additional @BaseCost@ Mana (max: @ManaCostCap@ Mana).
entries.spell_kogmawq_summary: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.
entries.spell_kogmawq_tooltip:
Passive: Kog'Maw gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds @ShredAmount@% Armor and Magic Resist for @ShredDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_kogmawvoidooze_summary: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.
entries.spell_kogmawvoidooze_tooltip: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and leaving a trail of ooze for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the ooze are <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowAmount@%.
entries.spell_landslide_summary: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.
entries.spell_landslide_tooltip: Malphite slams the ground, dealing <magicDamage>@EDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and reducing <attackSpeed>Attack Speed by @ASReduction@%</attackSpeed> for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_milioesinglebuff_summary: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.
entries.spell_milioesinglebuff_tooltip:
Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting @ShieldCalc@ Shield and @MoveSpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.
entries.spell_miliokickballq_summary: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.
entries.spell_miliokickballq_tooltip:
Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing @Damage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmountPercent@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with {{Spell_MilioKickballQ_Name}} refunds @RefundRatio*100@% of it's Mana cost.
entries.spell_miliopassive_summary: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
entries.spell_miliopassive_tooltip: When Milio's Abilities touch ally champions, their next Attack or Ability deals <physicalDamage>@ADBurstRatio@ ally Attack Damage</physicalDamage> as additional <magicDamage>magic damage</magicDamage>, plus <magicDamage>@BurnDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @BurnDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_miliopassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_MilioPassive_Tooltip}}

Burn damage does not stack from multiple hits.
entries.spell_milioq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Minions and monsters are knocked further and create a larger explosion.</rules>
entries.spell_milior_summary: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.
entries.spell_miliorfireflycannons_tooltip: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, restoring <healing>@HealCalc@ Health</healing>, and granting @TenacityAmount*100@% Tenacity for @TenacityDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_miliow_summary: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.
entries.spell_miliow_tooltip:
Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for @ZoneDuration@ seconds. Ally champions nearby gain @RangePercent@ Attack Range and restore @HealingOverTime@ Health over the duration. The hearth also applies {{Spell_MilioPassive_Name}} every @HealFrequencySeconds@ seconds.

Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.
entries.spell_miliowretarget_summary: Milio instructs his buff zone to follow a new target.
entries.spell_missfortunee_summary: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
entries.spell_missfortunee_tooltip: Miss Fortune rains bullets, revealing an area, <status>Slowing</status> by @TotalSlowAmount@ and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second for @BaseDuration@ seconds (total <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>).
entries.spell_missfortunee_tooltipsimple: Miss Fortune showers the area with bullets, damaging and slowing enemies.
entries.spell_missfortunepassive_summary: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.
entries.spell_missfortunepassive_tooltip:
Miss Fortune's Attacks deal an additional @TotalDamage@ physical damage when she attacks a new target.

Triggering {{ Spell_MissFortunePassive_Name }} reduces the cooldown of {{ Spell_MissfortuneW_Name }} by @Spell.MissFortuneViciousStrikes:LoveTapRefund@ seconds.
entries.spell_missfortuneq_summary: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.
entries.spell_missfortuneq_tooltip:
Miss Fortune fires a bouncing shot, dealing @TotalDamageTooltip@ physical damage to an enemy and to another one behind them.

The second shot can critically strike for @TotalDamageCrit@ physical damage. It always critically strikes if the first shot kills its target.
entries.spell_missfortuneq_tooltipsimple:
Fires a bouncing shot, damaging the target and another enemy behind.

If this kills the first target, deals extra damage to the second.
entries.spell_missfortuner_summary: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike
entries.spell_missfortuner_tooltip:
Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets, firing @BaseWaves@ waves over @BaseChannelDuration@ seconds, dealing @PhysicalDamagePerWave@ physical damage per wave (total @TotalPhysicalDamage@ physical damage).

Each wave can critically strike for %i:scaleCrit% @CritDamagePerWave@ physical damage.
entries.spell_missfortuner_tooltipsimple: <font color='#FF9900'>Channel:</font> Miss Fortune unleash a barrage of bullets, dealing massive damage.
entries.spell_missfortunew_summary: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.
entries.spell_missfortunew_tooltip:
Passive: After @PassiveBaseMSOOC@ seconds of not taking damage, Miss Fortune gains @PassiveBaseMS@ Move Speed. After another @PassiveMaxMSExtraOOC@ seconds, this increases to @PassiveMaxMS@.

Active: Gain the passive effect's full Move Speed bonus and @ActiveAS*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveDuration@ seconds.

Love Taps reduce the Cooldown of this Ability by @LoveTapRefund@ seconds.
entries.spell_missfortunew_tooltipsimple:
Passive: Gain up to @PassiveMaxMS@ Move Speed if you haven't taken damage recently.

Active: Gain @ActiveAS*100@% Attack Speed for @ActiveDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nasuse_summary: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.
entries.spell_nasuse_tooltip: Nasus ignites a spirit flame, dealing <magicDamage>@InitialDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemies in the area lose <scaleArmor>@ArmorShredPercent*-100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and take <magicDamage>@TotalDotDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_nasuspassive_summary: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.
entries.spell_nasuspassive_tooltip: Nasus has an additional @Spell.NasusPassive:LifestealTooltip@% Life Steal.
entries.spell_nasusq_summary: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.
entries.spell_nasusq_tooltip: Nasus' next Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Killing an enemy with this Attack permanently increases its damage by @BasicStacks@, increased to @BigStacks@ against champions, large minions and large jungle monsters.
entries.spell_nasusq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
{{ buff_desc_SpellEffects }}
This Ability can critically strike for @CritDamage@ physical damage.
entries.spell_nasusr_summary: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.
entries.spell_nasusr_tooltip:
Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by @BonusHealth@ and Armor and Magic Resistance by @InitialResistGain@.

While the storm rages, nearby enemies take @DamageCalc@ of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a @QCDR*100@% reduced Cooldown.
entries.spell_nasusr_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The storm deals a max of @MaxDamageCap@ damage per second.</rules>
entries.spell_nasusw_summary: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.
entries.spell_nasusw_tooltip: Nasus ages a champion, <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowBase@%, increasing to @MaxSlowTooltipOnly@% over @Duration@ seconds. Their <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> is also reduced by @AttackSpeedSlowMult*100@% of the <status>Slow</status>.
entries.spell_obduracy_summary: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.
entries.spell_obduracy_tooltip:
Passive: Malphite gains @BonusArmorPassive*100@% Armor (%i:scaleArmor%@f1@). This effect is increased to @BonusArmorPassive*300@% (%i:scaleArmor%@f2@) while Granite Shield is active.

Active: Malphite's next Attack deals an additional @TotalBonusDamage@ physical damage and creates an aftershock which deals @ThunderclapSplash@ physical damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit in their direction. His Attacks continue to create aftershocks %i:OnHit% On-Hit for the next @ThunderclapBuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_olafaxethrowcast_summary: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.
entries.spell_olafaxethrowcast_tooltip:
Olaf throws an axe, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*100@% for up to @MaxSlowDuration@ seconds (based on distance travelled). Champions hit lose @ShredAmount*100@% Armor for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.

If Olaf picks up the axe, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced to @TooltipCDRefund@ seconds, or fully refunded if @TooltipCDRefund@ seconds has elapsed.
entries.spell_olaffrenziedstrikes_summary: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.
entries.spell_olaffrenziedstrikes_tooltip: Olaf gains <attackSpeed>@Attackspeed*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @Duration@ seconds, and <shield>@BaseShield@ plus @ShieldPercMissingHP*100@% missing Health Shield (up to a maximum of @MaxShieldCalc@ Shield below @ThresholdForMax*100@% Health)</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_olafragnarok_summary: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.
entries.spell_olafragnarok_tooltip:
Passive: Olaf gains @Resists@ Armor and @Resists@ Magic Resist.

Active: Olaf cleanses all Immobilizing and Disabling effects on himself and becomes immune to them for @Duration@ seconds. While active, Olaf gains @AD@ Attack Damage. Hitting a champion with an Attack or Reckless Swing extends the duration by @DurationExtension@ seconds.

Additionally, Olaf gains @Haste*100@% Move Speed towards enemy champions for @HasteDuration@ second.
entries.spell_olafrecklessstrike_summary: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.
entries.spell_olafrecklessstrike_tooltip:
Olaf ferociously swings his axes, dealing @TotalDamage@ true damage. If the enemy dies, the cost is refunded.

Attacks lower the Cooldown of this Ability by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds when attacking monsters.
entries.spell_pykee_summary: Pyke dashes and leaves behind a phantom that will return to him, stunning enemy champions along its path.
entries.spell_pykee_tooltip: Pyke dashes, leaving a drowned phantom behind him that returns to him shortly. The phantom <status>Stuns</status> for @StunDuration@ seconds and deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to champions.
entries.spell_pykepassive_tooltip:
Pyke stores @OneEnemyCalc@ of damage taken from champions, increased to @AdditionalBonusCalc@ when there's more than one enemy nearby. Pyke can store up to @DamageStorageMax@ damage. While unseen by enemies, he rapidly regenerates this stored damage.

Additionally, Pyke converts all Maximum Health increases to Attack Damage instead at a rate of 14 Health to 1 Attack Damage.
entries.spell_pykeq_summary: Pyke either stabs an enemy in front of him or pulls an enemy towards him.
entries.spell_pykeq_tooltip:
Tap: Pyke stabs, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to the first enemy hit, preferring champions. They are then Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

Hold: Pyke throws his harpoon, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to the first enemy hit and Pulling them towards him. They are then Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

If Pyke successfully hits an enemy champion or the channel does not complete successfully, @ManaRefund*100@% of the Mana cost is refunded.
entries.spell_pyker_summary: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.
entries.spell_pyker_tooltip:
Pyke strikes all enemy champions in an X, teleporting to and executing targets below @RDamage@ Health. Champions above the threshold and non-champions instead take physical damage equal to @ReducedDamage*100@% of that amount (@ReducedDamageFinal@).

When an enemy champion dies inside the X, Pyke can Recast this Ability for free within @RRecastDuration@ seconds. If he executed that champion, the last assisting ally will also get kill gold. If he did not, he will still get kill gold as if he did.
entries.spell_pyker_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Total gold shared with allies: @f9@
Total gold kept for self: @f10@
entries.spell_pykew_summary: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.
entries.spell_pykew_tooltip: Pyke gains <keywordStealth>Camouflage</keywordStealth> and <speed>@MoveSpeed@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @CamoDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_reapthewhirlwind_summary: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
entries.spell_reapthewhirlwind_tooltip: Janna summons a magical monsoon, <status>Knocking Back</status> nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for <healing>@TotalHeal@ Health</healing> over @Duration@ seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.
entries.spell_reapthewhirlwind_tooltipextendedbe: <rules>The <status>Knock Back</status> cannot push enemies over walls.</rules>
entries.spell_recklessstrike_tooltipextendedbelo: <rules>Cast time scales based on bonus Attack Speed.</rules>
entries.spell_rupture_summary: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
entries.spell_rupture_tooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for @Effect5Amount@ second, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and <status>Slowing</status> them by @Effect2Amount@% for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.
entries.spell_seismicshard_summary: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.
entries.spell_seismicshard_tooltip: Malphite launches a shard of earth at an enemy, dealing <magicDamage>@QDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SpeedSteal@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Malphite also steals the amount <status>Slowed</status>, gaining it as <speed>Move Speed</speed> for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_sette_summary: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.
entries.spell_sette_tooltip:
Passive: Sett stores @DamageStored*100@% of damage taken as Grit, up to @MaxGrit@. Grit decays quickly @AdrenalineStorageWindow@ seconds after the damage was taken.

Active: Sett consumes all Grit, gaining a @ShieldConversion*100@% Grit consumed Shield decaying over @ShieldMaxDuration@ seconds. Sett then delivers a massive punch, dealing @DamageCalc@ plus @DamageConversion@ Grit consumed true damage to enemies in the center (max @f1@ damage). Enemies not in the center instead take physical damage.
entries.spell_settpassive_summary: Sett's basic attacks alternate between left and right punch. Right punch is slightly stronger and faster. Sett also hates losing, gaining additional health regeneration based off of his missing health.
entries.spell_settpassive_tooltip:
Sett's Attacks alternate between left and right punches. Right punches follow the left quickly and deal an additional @RightPunchBonus@ physical damage.

Sett gains @TooltipRegenPerMissingHealthCalc@ Health Regeneration for each @MissingHealthUnit*500@% missing Health.
entries.spell_settpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_SettPassive_Tooltip}}

Sett will reset back to a left punch if he does not do a right punch within 2 seconds of doing a left punch. The Attack Speed of a right punch is 8 times that of a left punch.
entries.spell_settq_summary: Sett's next two attacks deal additional damage based off of the target's max health. Sett also gains Move Speed while moving towards enemy champions.
entries.spell_settq_tooltip: Sett smashes enemies on either side of him into each other, dealing <physicalDamage>@DamageCalc@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. If Sett grabbed at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are <status>Stunned</status> for @StunDuration@ second.
entries.spell_settq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The Attacks are always a left and right punch. Deals a max of <physicalDamage>@MonsterCap@ damage</physicalDamage> to monsters per punch.</rules>
entries.spell_settr_summary: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.
entries.spell_settr_tooltip: Sett grabs an enemy champion and <status>Suppresses</status> them as he carries them forward, then slams them into the ground, dealing <physicalDamage>@DamageCalc@ plus @MaxHealthDamage*100@% of the grabbed enemy's bonus Health physical damage</physicalDamage> to surrounding enemies and <status>Slowing</status> them by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second. Enemies take less damage the further they are from where Sett lands.
entries.spell_settw_summary: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.
entries.spell_settw_tooltip:
Sett itches for a fight, gaining @MSAmount*100@% Move Speed towards enemy champions for @MSDuration@ seconds.

Additionally Sett's next two Attacks deal an additional @BaseDamage@ plus @MaxHealthDamageCalc@ max Health physical damage.
entries.spell_shene_summary: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
entries.spell_shene_tooltip:
Passive: Dealing damage with Twilight Assault or this Ability recovers @EnergyRefund@ Energy.

Active: Shen dashes, Taunting champions and jungle monsters for @CCDuration@ seconds and dealing @TauntDamage@ physical damage.
entries.spell_shenpassive_summary: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.
entries.spell_shenpassive_tooltip:
Shen gains @ShieldValue@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds after using an Ability. This effect has a @ShieldCooldown@ second Cooldown, reduced by @ShieldCooldownReduction@ seconds when one of Shen's Abilities successfully affects an ally or enemy.

Shen has a Spirit Blade that his other Abilities use.
entries.spell_shenq_summary: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.
entries.spell_shenq_tooltip:
Shen recalls his Spirit Blade. Enemies hit by the pull are Slowed by @SlowPercent@% while moving away from Shen for the next @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Additionally, Shen's next @NumEnhancedAttacks@ Attacks deal an additional @BaseFlatDamage@ plus @BasePercentHealth@ max Health magic damage. If Shen hit an enemy champion with the Spirit Blade, the damage is increased to @BaseFlatDamage@ plus @EmpPercentHealth@ max Health magic damage and he gains @SteroidAS@% Attack Speed for those Attacks.
entries.spell_shenq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Each Attack deals @MonsterAmp*100@% increased damage to jungle monsters (max @MinionDamageCap@ damage).
Attacks against structures deal @TowerDamageCalc@ damage.
entries.spell_shenr_summary: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.
entries.spell_shenr_tooltip: Shen grants an allied champion anywhere on the map between <shield>@Shield@</shield> and <shield>@MaxShield@ Shield</shield> based on their missing Health for @ShieldDuration@ seconds (max Shield at 60% missing Health). After channeling for @ChannelDuration@ seconds, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his <keywordMajor>Spirit Blade</keywordMajor>.
entries.spell_shenw_summary: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.
entries.spell_shenw_tooltip:
Shen creates a defensive zone at his Spirit Blade for @ZoneDuration@ seconds. Attacks against allied champions in the zone are blocked.

If there are no champions to protect in the zone when it starts, it will wait for up to @ZoneDelay@ seconds.
entries.spell_sonae_summary: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.
entries.spell_sonae_tooltip:
Active: She begins a new Melody and grants herself @TotalSelfMovementSpeed@ Move Speed for @SelfMovementSpeedDurationMin@ seconds, extended to up to @SelfMovementSpeedDurationMax@ seconds if she doesn't take damage.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for @AuraDuration@ seconds that grants allied champions @TotalAllyMovementSpeed@ Move Speed for @AllyMovementSpeedDuration@ seconds.

Power Chord - Tempo: Power Chord also Slows the target by @TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@ for @TempoDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_sonapassive_summary:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.
entries.spell_sonapassive_tooltip:
Accelerando: Sona gains Accelerando stacks from using her Basic Abilities well. She gains +%i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoAHPerStack@ Basic Ability Haste permanently per stack, up to %i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoCap@ Basic Ability Haste. When she reaches %i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoCap@ Basic Ability Haste, instead of gaining further stacks her current Ultimate Ability's cooldown is reduced by @Spell.SonaPassive:AccelerandoUltCDR@ seconds.

Power Chord: After using @PowerChordPassiveCountMax@ basic Abilities, Sona's next Attack deals an additional @PowerChordDamage@ magic damage and may have an additional effect based on the song Sona last activated.
  • Hymn of Valor: The Attack deals @Spell.SonaQ:TotalStaccatoDamage@ magic damage instead.
  • Aria of Perseverance: The target deals @Spell.SonaW:TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@ less damage for @Spell.SonaW:DiminuendoDuration@ seconds.
  • Song of Celerity: The target is Slowed by @Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@ for @Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_sonaq_summary: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.
entries.spell_sonaq_tooltip:
Sona deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the nearest two enemies, prioritizing champions. She then begins a new Melody. Gain a stack of Accelerando for every champion you damage with this.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for @AuraDuration@ seconds, granting allied champions an additional @TotalOnHitDamage@ magic damage %i:OnHit% on their next Attack within @OnHitDuration@ seconds.

Power Chord - Staccato: Power Chord bonus damage (@TotalStaccatoDamage@ total magic damage).
entries.spell_sonar_summary: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.
entries.spell_sonar_tooltip: Sona strikes an irresistible chord, <status>Stunning</status> enemy for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_sonar_tooltipextendedbelowline: Enemies that know how to dance, will dance during the stun.
entries.spell_sonaw_summary: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.
entries.spell_sonaw_tooltip:
Active: Sona restores @TotalHeal@ Health to herself and a nearby allied champion, prioritizing the most wounded. She then begins a new Melody.

Melody: Sona gains an aura for @AuraDuration@ seconds, granting allied champions @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

Gain a stack of Accelerando whenever you heal another injured ally and every time you protect another ally from at least @AccelerandoShieldBreakpoint@ damage with this shield.

Power Chord - Diminuendo: Power Chord also reduces physical and magic damage dealt by the target by @TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@ for @DiminuendoDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_sowthewind_summary: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
entries.spell_sowthewind_tooltip:
Passive: Janna gains @TotalMS@ Move Speed and is Ghosted.

Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by @TotalSlow@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds, and dealing @TotalDamage@ + @spell.TailwindSelf:BonusDamage@ magic damage.
entries.spell_sowthewind_tooltipextendedbelowlin: Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
entries.spell_tailwindself_summary:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.
entries.spell_tailwindself_tooltip:
Ally champions gain @MSPercentAlly*100@% Move Speed moving towards Janna.

Janna deals @BonusDamage@ bonus magic damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} and with Zephyr.
entries.spell_tarice_summary: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
entries.spell_tarice_tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after @ChargeDuration@ second to deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stun</status> enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_taricpassive_summary: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.
entries.spell_taricpassive_tooltip: After using an Ability, Taric's next 2 Attacks within @Duration@ seconds gain <attackSpeed>100% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, deal an additional <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, and reduce his basic Ability Cooldowns by @CDR@ second.
entries.spell_taricq_summary: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
entries.spell_taricq_tooltip:
Passive: Gain a stack (max @MaxCharges@) every @StackCooldown@ seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore @HealingPerStack@ Health per stack to nearby ally champions (@MaxStackHealing@ at @MaxCharges@ stacks).
entries.spell_taricr_summary: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
entries.spell_taricr_tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After @InitialDelay@ seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for @InvulnDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_taricw_summary:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
entries.spell_taricw_tooltip:
Passive: Taric gains @BonusArmor@ Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains @BonusArmor@ Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a @ShieldHPRatio@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_taricw_tooltipextended:
Mimicked spell effects do not stack.
Only one ally can be bound at a time.
entries.spell_teemoe_summary: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.
entries.spell_teemoe_tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Teemo's Attacks apply poison %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing an additional <magicDamage>@ImpactCalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> plus <magicDamage>@TotalDotDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoisonDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_teemoe_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>This poison deals @MonsterMod*100@% damage to jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_teemoq_summary: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.
entries.spell_teemoq_tooltip: Teemo fires a dart, <status>Blinding</status> the target for @BlindDuration@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@CalculatedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_teemoq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Minions and jungle monsters are <status>Blinded</status> for @MinionMonsterDurationMod*100@% longer.</rules>
entries.spell_teemor_summary: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.
entries.spell_teemor_tooltip:
Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by @SlowAmount@% and deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @DebuffDuration@ seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration.

Traps last @MushroomDuration@ minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has @MaxAmmo@ charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
entries.spell_teemow_summary: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.
entries.spell_teemow_tooltip:
Passive: Teemo gains @PassiveMoveSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last @PassiveCooldownOnDamageTaken@ seconds.

Active: Teemo sprints, gaining @ActiveMoveSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for @ActiveMoveSpeedBuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_tryndameree_summary: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
entries.spell_tryndameree_tooltip:
Tryndamere spins through his enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and generating @NonChampFuryGain@ Fury per enemy hit, increased to @ChampFuryGain@ Fury against enemy champions.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by @NonChampCDRefund@ seconds when Tryndamere critically strikes, and reduced by @ChampCDRefund@ seconds when critically striking a champion.
entries.spell_tryndamerepassive_tooltip:
Tryndamere's Attacks grant him 5 Fury or 10 Fury for a critical strike, and 10 Fury for killing a unit. After 8 seconds of being out of combat, Tryndamere loses 5 Fury every second.

Each point of Fury grants @PassiveCritConversionTooltip@% Critical Strike Chance.
entries.spell_tryndamereq_summary: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.
entries.spell_tryndamereq_tooltip:
Passive: Tryndamere thirsts for blood, gaining up to @MaximumBonusAD@ Attack Damage based on his missing Health.

Active: Tryndamere consumes his Fury, restoring @BaseHeal@ plus @HealPerFury@ Health per Fury (max: @MaximumHeal@).
entries.spell_tryndamereq_tooltipextendedbelowli: <rules>Maximum Attack Damage gained at @RemainingHealthThreshold*100@% remaining Health.</rules>
entries.spell_tryndamerew_summary: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.
entries.spell_tryndamerew_tooltip: Tryndamere hurls insults, reducing champions' Attack Damage by @ADReduction*-1@ for @ReductionDuration@ seconds and <status>Slowing</status> by @SlowPotency*-100@% while cowering from him for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_ufslash_summary: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.
entries.spell_ufslash_tooltip: Malphite charges with the force of a landslide, dashing Unstoppably. At the end of the dash, Malphite <status>Knocks Up</status> for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_undyingrage_summary: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.
entries.spell_undyingrage_tooltip: Tryndamere becomes completely immune to death for @TryndRDuration@ seconds, refusing to be reduced below @TryndRMinHealth@ Health, and instantly gains <keywordMajor>@TryndRFuryGain@ Fury</keywordMajor>.
entries.spell_volibeare_summary: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius.
entries.spell_volibeare_tooltip:
Volibear summons a thundercloud that fires a lightning bolt, dealing @TotalDamageTooltip@ plus @PercentDamage*100@% max Health magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a @ShieldAPRatioTooltip@ plus @ShieldAmount*100@% max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_volibearp_summary: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.
entries.spell_volibearp_tooltip:
Volibear gains @AttackSpeedCalc@ Attack Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional @ChainLightningDamage@ magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.
entries.spell_volibearq_summary: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, <status>Stunning</status> and damaging the first one he Attacks.
entries.spell_volibearq_tooltip:
Volibear gains @MinSpeedCalc@ Move Speed, doubled to @MaxSpeedCalc@ towards enemy champions for the next @Duration@ seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals @CalculatedDamage@ physical damage and Stuns the target for @StunDuration@ second.

Volibear becomes enraged if an enemy Immobilizes him before he Stuns a target, ending the Ability early but refreshing its Cooldown.
entries.spell_volibearq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Volibear gains @BonusRange@ attack range for this attack.</rules>
entries.spell_volibearr_summary: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health.  Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.
entries.spell_volibearr_tooltip:
Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining @HealthAmount@ Health and @BonusAttackRange@ Attack Range for the next @TransformDuration@ seconds.

Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for @TowerDisableDuration@ seconds and dealing @TowerDamageTooltip@ physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffer @SweetSpotDamageTooltip@ physical damage.
entries.spell_volibearw_summary: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them.  Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.
entries.spell_volibearw_tooltip:
Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and marking them for @MarkDuration@ seconds.

If this Ability is used on a marked target, its damage is increased to @EmpoweredDamage@ and Volibear restores @BaseHeal@ plus @PercentMissingHealthHealingRatio@ missing Health.
entries.spell_volibearw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Empowered damage scales with %i:scaleAD% (Damage multiplier: @W2DamageMultiplier*100@% + @W2BonusADDamageMultiplier*10000@%)
This Ability applies on-hit effects.
Healing is @MinionAndMonsterMod*100@% effective against minions.
entries.spell_vorpalspikes_summary: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.
entries.spell_vorpalspikes_tooltip: Cho'Gath's next 3 Attacks launch spikes that deal <magicDamage>@FlatDamageCalc@ plus @MaxHealthPercentCalc@ of the target's max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> by @SlowAmountPercentage@%, decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_vorpalspikes_tooltipextendedbelowl:
Feast stacks increase the width of the spikes and the max Health damage by @FeastStackMultiplier@% per stack.
Percent Health damage against monsters is replaced with @ModifiedMonsterCap@.
entries.spell_xayahe_summary: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.
entries.spell_xayahe_tooltip: Xayah calls all <keywordMajor>Feathers</keywordMajor> back to her, dealing <physicalDamage>@FeatherDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> each. If @FeatherThreshold@ or more <keywordMajor>Feathers</keywordMajor> hit an enemy, they are <status>Rooted</status> for @RootDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_xayahe_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritRatio*100@% effectiveness.
Minions take @MinionMultiplier*100@% damage from this Ability.
Enemies take 5% less damage per feather hit, to a minimum of 10% damage.
entries.spell_xayahpassive_summary: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a <font color='#C200E1'>Feather</font>.
entries.spell_xayahpassive_tooltip:
After using an Ability, Xayah's next @f14@ Attacks will deal @f16*100@% damage to all other targets along their path and leave a Feather for @f12@ seconds.

Lover's Leap: Xayah and Rakan can recall together.
entries.spell_xayahpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_XayahPassive_Tooltip}}

Primary target of empowered Attacks take full damage and On-Hit effects as normal.
entries.spell_xayahq_summary: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.
entries.spell_xayahq_tooltip: Xayah throws two daggers, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> each and leaving two <keywordMajor>Feathers</keywordMajor>. Targets hit after the first take <physicalDamage>@MultiHitDamage@ damage</physicalDamage> from each dagger.
entries.spell_xayahr_summary: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.
entries.spell_xayahr_tooltip: Xayah leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for 1.5 seconds before raining down daggers that deal <physicalDamage>@Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and leave behind a line of <keywordMajor>Feathers</keywordMajor>.
entries.spell_xayahr_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Untargetable units won't be affected by enemy Attacks or Abilities unless they've already been affected by them.
Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
Xayah can move while in the air.
entries.spell_xayahw_summary: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.
entries.spell_xayahw_tooltip:
Xayah creates a storm of blades for @WAttackSpeedDuration@ seconds that grants her @WAttackSpeedAmount@% Attack Speed and cause her Attacks to fire a secondary blade that deals @BonusDamagePercent@% damage.

When the secondary blade hits a champion, she grants herself @WMoveSpeedAmount@% Move Speed for @WMoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this Ability, except he gains Move Speed when Xayah strikes a target.
